toolsPreview.name: register
toolsPreview.description: Register an agent (1 signed call, idempotent).

toolsPreview.name: resolve
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a DID -> DID Document + metadata (public).

toolsPreview.name: get_reputation
toolsPreview.description: Returns the live Reputation VC (public, always present).

toolsPreview.name: declare_succession
toolsPreview.description:
mcp-v2: registers a self-signed Succession Statement
(SPEC-succession-v1). Append-only, declarative, no transfer.

toolsPreview.name: declare_principal
toolsPreview.description:
mcp-v2: registers a Principal Binding signed by the principal
(SPEC-principal-binding-v1). Binds an agent to an accountable
person/organization (did:key/did:web). Append-only, declarative, anti-Sybil.

toolsPreview.name: declare_receipt
toolsPreview.description:
mcp-v2: registers an Interaction Receipt signed by an accountable
counterpart (SPEC-reputation-receipt-v1). review/dispute -> feeds the
score. Append-only, anti self-attestation, anti-Sybil (bound issuer).
